اقتبلا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَلَا (iqtabalā) /iq.ta.ba.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اُقْتُبِلَا (uqtubilā) /uq.tu.bi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اِقْتَبِلَا (iqtabilā) /iq.ta.bi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
